options.alt: Line A B and ray A C intersect at point A. Line A B runs up and down. Ray A C runs right to left. A circle arc centered at point A intersects line A B at point D and intersects ray A C at point E. A circle arc centered at point E intersects point D. A circle arc centered at point C intersects ray A C at point F. A circle arc centered at point F intersects the circle centered at point C at point G.

Line A B and ray A C intersect at point A. Line A B runs up and down. Ray A C runs right to left. A circle arc centered at point A intersects line A B at point D and intersects ray A C at point E. A circle arc centered at point E intersects point D. A circle arc centered at point C intersects ray A C at point F. A circle arc centered at point F intersects the circle centered at point C at point G. A line goes through points C and G.

hints.content:
As a result, we have $\triangle ADE \cong \triangle CGF$ by side-side-side congruence.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Line A B and ray A C intersect at point A. Line A B runs up and down. Ray A C runs right to left. A circle arc centered at point A intersects line A B at point D and intersects ray A C at point E. A circle arc centered at point E intersects point D. A circle arc centered at point C intersects ray A C at point F. A circle arc centered at point F intersects the circle centered at point C at point G. A line goes through points C and G. Segments A D, A E, and D E form a triangle. Segments C G, C F, and F G form a triangle. Segments A D, A E, C G, and C F are congruent. Segments D E and F G are congruent.

hints.content:
And $\angle GCF \cong \angle BAC$ since they are corresponding parts of congruent triangles.

question.content:
Anika constructed angle $\angle GCF$ congruent to $\angle BAC$.

choices.content: They are corresponding angles of congruent triangles $\triangle DAC$ & $\triangle GCA$.
They are corresponding angles of congruent triangles $\triangle ADE$ & $\triangle CGF$.
